Name: Another Shane Portrait
Author: HelloStranger
Description:
A slightly different portrait for Shane that I figured I'd share. Figured out how to edit xnb files and made this for reasons. Hope that you enjoy and let me know if I somehow messed something up!

To Install:
1. Locate the Portraits folder in your Stardew Valley install location by going to Content>Portraits
2. Locate the original Shane.xnb file and BACK IT UP IN ANOTHER LOCATION!
3. Open the AnotherShane file and drop the modified Shane.xnb in the Portraits folder, allow it to overwrite.
4. Enjoy!
